## 2) Collisions if moving `test/*` → `tools/*` (same relative structure)

**Exact path/filename collisions: none.**

Overlapping directories that would merge (not overwrite):

| Overlap | `test` adds | `tools` already has |
|---|---|---|
| `qa/` | `README.md`, `canon_consistency_audit.gd`, `qa_canon_validators.gd` | 3 `.py` scripts + `run_default_playtest.ps1` |
| `visual_style/` | `README.md`, 3 `.gd` scripts, `shaders/` | `run_scene_1_1_style_sweep.ps1`, `output/scanline_glitch_comparison/` |

No conflicts for:

- `test/scene_smoke_check.gd` → `tools/scene_smoke_check.gd` (new)
- `test/bots/` → `tools/bots/` (new folder)

**Near-duplicates (same role, different paths — not filesystem conflicts):**

- `test/visual_style/capture_scene_1_1_style_sweep.gd` ↔ `tools/visual_style/run_scene_1_1_style_sweep.ps1`
- `test/qa/qa_canon_validators.gd` ↔ `tools/qa/canon_validators_shared.py`

---

## 3) `visual_style` under `test` → destination under `tools`

Only one visual-style folder in `test`:

| Source | Destination (same structure) |
|---|---|
| `test/visual_style/` | `tools/visual_style/` |
| `test/visual_style/shaders/` | `tools/visual_style/shaders/` (new; no `shaders/` exists in `tools` today) |

Existing `tools/visual_style/output/` is untouched by the move; merged tree would be:

```
tools/visual_style/
├── run_scene_1_1_style_sweep.ps1          (existing)
├── README.md                               (from test)
├── capture_scene_1_1_style_sweep.gd        (from test)
├── style_overlay_applier.gd                (from test)
├── variant_matrix.gd                       (from test)
├── shaders/                                (from test)
└── output/scanline_glitch_comparison/      (existing)
```
